tasks.analysis: Pigments are substances that provide color to materials, and they can be derived from various natural sources, such as minerals and plants. It was once common for artists to create their own paints by mixing several pigments together. This process was time-consuming and required detailed knowledge of pigments—their chemical properties, how they interact with different media, and their durability over time. But it also allowed painters to give their artworks a truly unique color palette. 颜料是为物质提供颜色的物质，可从矿物、植物等多种天然来源提取。过去，艺术家们通常会自行混合多种颜料制作颜料。这一过程非常耗时，且需要掌握详尽的颜料知识 —— 包括其化学特性、与不同介质的反应方式以及长期耐久性。但这也让画家能够为作品打造真正独特的色调。
